description: Find Wayback Machine snapshots of a URL. Mode "closest" returns the single nearest capture to a given timestamp via the Availability API, falling back to a CDX closest-capture query when the Availability API has no answer (one result). Mode "history" returns the full capture list via the CDX API — filterable by date range, HTTP status code, and MIME type, collapsed by default to one capture per day (collapse=timestamp:8). Use history mode to survey how a page changed over time; use closest mode when you need the snapshot nearest a specific date. history mode supports resume-key pagination for URLs with very large capture histories.

collapse.description: CDX collapse parameter (history mode only). Format: "timestamp:N" where N is 1–14 (4=year, 6=month, 8=day, 10=hour, 14=exact). Default "timestamp:8" collapses to one per day. Pass an empty string or omit to get uncollapsed results.

from.description: Start of date range filter in YYYYMMDD format (history mode only). Example: "20200101".

limit.description: Maximum number of CDX records to return (history mode only, default 100).

mode.description: Lookup mode: "closest" returns the single nearest snapshot to the given timestamp; "history" returns the paginated full capture list via the CDX API.

resume_key.description: Opaque pagination key from a previous history mode response. Pass this to continue from where the last page left off.

status_filter.description: Filter CDX results to a specific HTTP status code (history mode only). Must be a 3-digit numeric code. Example: "200" to return only successful captures.

timestamp.description: Target timestamp in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format (or any prefix thereof). Required for mode=closest. Example: "20200101" for January 1, 2020.

to.description: End of date range filter in YYYYMMDD format (history mode only). Example: "20231231".

url.description: The URL to look up in the Wayback Machine.

name: ia_find_snapshots

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_timestamp`: Closest mode was called without a timestamp, or with a blank one. `no_snapshots`: No snapshots found for the given URL with the current filters. `no_snapshot_available`: No capture exists near the requested timestamp for this URL. `cdx_unavailable`: The Wayback CDX API answered HTTP 5xx after retries or 429, or returned an unreadable response; in closest mode, the CDX closest-capture check failed or did not complete in time. `availability_unavailable`: The Wayback Availability API answered HTTP 5xx after retries or 429, or returned an unreadable response (closest mode). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

resume_key.description: Opaque key to pass as resume_key in the next call to continue paginating CDX history results.

snapshots.description: List of snapshots matching the query.

items.description: A single Wayback Machine snapshot record.

digest.description: SHA-1 digest of the content (history mode).

mimetype.description: MIME type of the captured content (history mode).

replay_url.description: Full Wayback Machine replay URL for this snapshot.

statuscode.description: HTTP status code at time of capture ("-" for a revisit record).

truncated.description: True when the snapshot list was capped at the limit.

title: Find Wayback Machine Snapshots
